outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. SIX original painted tactical battle sprites, THREE columns TWO rows, large clear gutters. Image1 is primary identity/style reference; image2 canonical identity. SAME lean shaggy brown-gray Fenhound courier, long muzzle, upright ears, amber eyes, turquoise painted streaks on cheeks/back/flanks, mossy leather harness with small parcels and round bronze collar token, bushy tail. Fixed slightly elevated three-quarter view facing RIGHT, same anatomical proportions all six. Exactly four canine legs, one tail, same harness/markings. TOP LEFT: hind-foot push phase before gallop suspension, both hind toes supporting beneath/behind hips while forelegs lift folded in front, spine extends; do not rotate body. TOP MIDDLE: fore-foot landing after extended suspension, near forepaw bearing weight forward under shoulder, far forepaw just ahead touching, hind legs trail airborne behind LEFT; chest lowers. TOP RIGHT: recovery after bite, four paws grounded, foreknees soften, neck draws back and muzzle closed, tail low. BOTTOM LEFT: bite CONTACT, neck reaches forward RIGHT, jaws CLOSED firmly, four distinct braced legs and balanced torso; no target or blood. BOTTOM MIDDLE: low defensive brace deeper than reference, forelegs spread and bent, chest guarded behind forelegs, ears laid back, eyes open, muzzle closed. BOTTOM RIGHT: intermediate side collapse, HEAD toward RIGHT, forelegs buckle sideways and chest rests on ground, hips rolling down but not yet fully settled, four limp bent legs, eyes closing, harness/parcels and tail intact. Keep full paw/claw and tail outlines, no speed trails or floor shadows. Uniform pure GREEN RGB(0,255,0) background with no green spill/reflected light, no scenery, text, grid, or logos. Original painterly raster, not diagram.
outputs.selection_notes: New hind push, fore landing, recovery, closed bite, low raised-paw guard and side-lowering paintings; far-hind separation and guard support remain review.
